answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 39 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in ferrous, queued in haven, and glacier publishes the wait time. A farm of 221 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2415 identities would post 828 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
